archetypes.name: bg-wait-marker-integrity
archetypes.rationale: Checks clone-scoping and lint coverage for bg-wait marker ownership drift.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan for bg-wait marker clone identity coverage. Focus on whether the new lint actually prevents future marker writers from omitting marker-local CLONE_PATH stamps without flagging hook consumers or tests. Check that the Step 3 shell change preserves fail-open behavior and sibling-writer parity. Cite every finding with file:line evidence. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
